notes.title: Iron Armor Storm's new server announcement on February 26th
notes.notes:
Dear commanders

A new round of battles is about to begin, and the classic World War II themed strategy game "Armor Storm" will start its 264 server on February 26th. At that time, we will embark on a brand new journey with our commanders, master the power of armor, lead a powerful tank force, and engage in strategic battles!

Server: 264 server Military Alliance

notes.title: Iron Armor Storm Christmas New Year Event
notes.notes:
1、 Modern Collection (December 23-24)
Rhine series new 19 point collection light tank - Ru251
2、 Christmas gift package (December 23-27)
During the event, consuming diamonds to purchase accessories will increase the bonus, as well as rare items such as accessory skill books and modern red transformation orders.
3、 Double Dan Gift Exchange (December 23-January 1)
During the event, attacking regular levels, elite levels, and challenging world bosses can all earn limited items, which can be used to exchange for items such as Christmas decorations.
4、 Triple Diamond (December 23-January 5)
During the event, each recharge level will receive three times the diamond for the first recharge.
5、 Limited time recharge rebate (December 23-January 5)
During the event, if the accumulated recharge reaches a certain level, additional rewards can be claimed.

Server: 245 servers beyond borders
